name: Bromyard Foodshare
description: Local food support service operating from Bromyard Methodist Church. Open Tue and Sat 10am-12pm. Provides emergency food parcels and signposting to other services. Self-referral and agency referrals accepted.

name: Bromyard Town Council Allotments
short_description: 3 allotment sites managed by Bromyard Town Council
description: Bromyard Town Council manages allotments at Hereford Road
image: and Willersley Road. Plots from £25 per year. Contact the Town Clerk for availability and waiting lists.

name: Bromyard Community Garden
short_description: Community garden with herb spiral and polytunnel
description: Run by Bromyard Community Group with 20 vegetable plots and a communal herb spiral. Open during daylight hours with volunteer days Wed and Sat mornings.
